"Hey, Have You Tried Cheese" vs "Secret Ingredient" Dish Towel: Which Funny Kitchen Towel Is Worth It? (2026)

Two $13.99 Blue Q cotton dish towels with identical specs and very different punchlines. Absorbency, print quality, washability, and gifting — compared.

Published October 22, 2026 · Based on verified Amazon product data and real customer outcomes

A funny dish towel is one of the most reliable small gifts you can buy. It hits the sweet spot: useful enough that nobody feels awkward receiving it, cheap enough that it works as a hostess gift or a stocking stuffer, and personal enough that it never reads as filler. The catch is that "funny" is doing a lot of work in that sentence — the towel still has to dry a wine glass without leaving lint behind.

Blue Q has quietly become the go-to brand for this category, and two of its towels are the ones people keep landing on: "Hey, Have You Tried Cheese" and "B-h I Am The Secret Ingredient." Both cost $13.99, both are 100% cotton, both measure 28" x 21", and both are printed with food-safe inks. So the decision isn't really about specs — it's about who you're buying for and how bold you want the joke to be.

Here's the honest breakdown of both, and who each one is actually right for.

Quick Verdict

Buy "Hey, Have You Tried Cheese" if: You want a towel that works as a gift for almost anyone — coworkers, relatives, a neighbor, a teacher, a host. The cheese line is absurd and innocuous; there's no profanity, no inside joke to explain, and it lands with people from 15 to 85. It's the safer, more universal pick.

Buy "Secret Ingredient" if: You're buying for someone who'll appreciate a bolder, sassier line — a best friend, a sibling, a real cook with a sense of humor about themselves. It's the funnier towel, but it's also the one you don't hand to your boss.

Our pick: The Cheese Dish Towel. Identical quality, same price, and dramatically broader gifting range. When two products are this close on performance, the one you can give to more people wins.

They're the Same Towel (Almost)

It's worth being blunt here: these two towels come off the same production philosophy. Both are 100% cotton, both are the same size, both use the same food-safe screen-print process, and both carry the same care instructions and the same ethical sourcing claim. If you lined them up and removed the text, you'd struggle to tell them apart by feel.

That's actually good news. It means you can't make a "bad" choice on performance. The absorbency is strong enough for real kitchen use — not just decorative hanging — and the lint-free finish is the detail that makes it usable on stemware rather than being relegated to the "pretty but useless" category a lot of printed towels fall into.

The one performance claim worth noting is durability of the print. Screen-printed towels with food-safe inks are designed to hold color through repeated washing without the design going chalky or peeling. Skip the bleach (both brands say so explicitly) and they'll keep looking new far longer than the heat-press vinyl prints you see on cheap novelty towels.

"Same fabric, same size, same price. This comparison comes down to one question: who is going to read it?"

How to Choose in Ten Seconds

Choose the cheese towel if the answer to "who's getting this?" is anyone outside your closest circle. It's the version that works at a white-elephant exchange, as a housewarming add-on, for a teacher gift, or wrapped around a cheese board. It's also the better choice if you're buying several at once — it's the one that works for every recipient on the list, so you can buy in multiples without worrying about who can handle the joke.

Choose the secret ingredient towel if it's a one-person gift for someone with a thick skin and a real sense of humor — the friend who claims they're the reason the recipe works. It's the funnier towel of the two, and the right recipient will genuinely keep it. It just narrows the list of people you can hand it to.

💡 Price note: Both towels sit at $13.99, and Blue Q towels go on sale surprisingly often — especially in multi-packs. If you're buying for a group, watch for bundle pricing rather than buying singles one at a time.

Who Should Buy Which

✅ Buy the Cheese Towel if you...

  • Need a gift-safe joke for anyone
  • Are buying several towels at once
  • Want a hostess or housewarming add-on
  • Prefer wholesome over edgy humor
  • Want the most broadly useful kitchen towel

✅ Buy the Secret Ingredient Towel if you...

  • Are buying for one close friend
  • Know they'll love the bolder line
  • Want the bigger laugh factor
  • Are gifting a confident home cook
  • Don't need it to be office-safe

The Bottom Line

Our Take

These are the same towel with two different jokes, and at $13.99 neither one is a stretch. The "Hey, Have You Tried Cheese" towel takes our pick purely because it's the version you can buy in bulk and hand out without a second thought — same cotton, same size, same print quality, wider gifting range.

If you know exactly who's getting it and they'll appreciate the sharper line, the "Secret Ingredient" towel is the funnier buy. Either way, you're getting a real kitchen towel that happens to be a punchline — not a novelty that fails the first time it meets a wet glass.
